title: Resident Appreciation Schedule — Residence Courtesy on the Final Month of an Independent Living Residency
content:
A settling resident under the Independent Living Residency Agreement receives a residence courtesy on the final month's base fee charge, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date to the day of posting.

| Whole calendar months in residence | Residence courtesy |
|---|---|
| 60 months or more | 2.0 percent |
| 12 months or more but fewer than 60 months | 1.0 percent |
| Fewer than 12 months | None |

The courtesy percentage reduces the final month's base fee charge before rounding. Where more than one courtesy percentage applies to the same charge, the percentages are added into one total and the charge is reduced once by that total — the courtesies do not act one after another — and the result is rounded once to the cent half up.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Move-in date | Day of posting | Whole months | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|---|
| October 8, 2021 | October 7, 2026 | 59 | 1.0 percent |
| October 8, 2021 | October 8, 2026 | 60 | 2.0 percent |
| October 8, 2025 | October 7, 2026 | 11 | None |
| October 8, 2025 | October 8, 2026 | 12 | 1.0 percent |

## Hypothetical figure

A final month's charge of 3,000.00 before rounding, with a residence courtesy of 2.0 percent as the only courtesy, becomes 3,000.00 reduced by 2.0 percent, that is 2,940.00.
